# snapcd Provider

Interact with snapcd.

The provider authenticates with the first of these that is set, in the configuration or the environment: `access_token`; `client_id` with `client_secret`; `client_id` with `federated_token_file`. When none is set, it asks the snapcd CLI for the signed-in user's token, as the azurerm provider asks the Azure CLI. Run `snapcd login` first. The Server URL, the organization and `insecure_skip_verify` then also come from the CLI context, unless they are set. `SNAPCD_CLI_CONTEXT` picks a context other than the current one, and `SNAPCD_CLI_PATH` names the CLI binary when it is not `snapcd` on the PATH.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Authenticate with Service Principal

variable "client_id" {}
variable "client_secret" { sensitive = true }
variable "organization_id" {}

provider "snapcd" {
  client_id       = var.client_id
  client_secret   = var.client_secret
  organization_id = var.organization_id
}

# Or alternatively, authenticate with Access Token:
#
# variable "access_token" { sensitive = true }
#
# provider "snapcd" {
#   access_token    = var.access_token
#   organization_id = var.organization_id
# }

# Or, signed in with the snapcd CLI (`snapcd login`), with no credentials at all. The Server URL
# and the organization come from the CLI context:
#
# provider "snapcd" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_token` (String) Access token for the SnapCd API. Either this, or 'client_id' with 'client_secret' or 'federated_token_file', must be set. Can also be set via the SNAPCD_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable.
- `client_id` (String) Client ID for a Service Principal to authenticate API calls with. Either this or 'access_token' must be set. Can also be set via the SNAPCD_CLIENT_ID environment variable.
- `client_secret` (String) Client Secret for a Service Principal to authenticate API calls with. Either this or 'access_token' must be set. Can also be set via the SNAPCD_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable.
- `federated_token_file` (String) Path to a file holding a token that matches a Federated Credential of the Service Principal named by 'client_id', for example a projected Kubernetes ServiceAccount token. Used when 'client_secret' is not set. Can also be set via the SNAPCD_FEDERATED_TOKEN_FILE environment variable.
- `health_check_interval_seconds` (Number) Number of seconds to wait inbetween polling the /health endpoint of the API. Defaults to 10 seconds. Can also be set via the SNAPCD_HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS environment variable.
- `health_check_timeout_seconds` (Number) Number of seconds during which to continuously poll /health endpoint before timing out. Defaults to 60 seconds. Can also be set via the SNAPCD_HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS environment variable.
- `hold_modules` (Boolean) Hold the Modules this run creates or changes, and every Module in the Namespaces and Stacks it changes, so that none of their jobs start until the run has finished writing. The hold is kept alive by a heartbeat while the provider runs and lapses on its own shortly after it exits, so parallel applies touching the same Modules keep it alive together. Defaults to true. Can also be set via the SNAPCD_HOLD_MODULES environment variable.
- `hold_modules_heartbeat_buffer_seconds` (Number) Number of seconds a hold outlasts the heartbeat interval before it lapses. Unset, the server's default is used. The server keeps it within its own limits, and warns once if it had to change it. Can also be set via the SNAPCD_HOLD_MODULES_HEARTBEAT_BUFFER_SECONDS environment variable.
- `hold_modules_heartbeat_interval_seconds` (Number) Number of seconds between the heartbeats that keep Module holds alive. Unset, the server's default is used. The server keeps it within its own limits, and warns once if it had to change it. Can also be set via the SNAPCD_HOLD_MODULES_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS environment variable.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip verifying the HTTPs certificate of the API. Can also be set via the SNAPCD_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY environment variable.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID for the SnapCd API. Can also be set via the SNAPCD_ORGANIZATION_ID environment variable.
- `url` (String) URL where the Snapcd API is served. Defaults to https://snapcd.io. Can also be set via the SNAPCD_URL environment variable.
